codeReview.summary: The theme system migration is well-implemented. ThemeProvider context correctly manages light/dark mode and palette selection with localStorage persistence. All 16 palettes (8 light + 8 dark) are defined as CSS variable selectors in index.css using data-attribute selectors. The ThemeToggle component uses shadcn Switch with proper accessibility. An inline blocking script in index.html prevents flash-of-wrong-theme on load. 41 comprehensive tests cover palette validation, context behavior, toggle rendering, persistence, and error boundaries. TypeScript compilation and all tests pass cleanly.

issues.description: PaletteName is typed as `string` rather than a union of valid palette names. This means TypeScript won't catch invalid palette names at compile time — only at runtime via validatePalette(). Consider using a union type like `type PaletteName = 'github' | 'spacegray' | ...` for stricter type safety.

Feature description specified converting palettes to oklch/hsl color space, but all palette values remain in hex (#ffffff format). Hex values work correctly with Tailwind v4's @theme inline directive, so this is functionally fine, but the color space conversion was not done as described.

VAL-THEME-004 requires smooth theme transitions, but no CSS transition property is defined on :root or body for color/background changes. Consider adding `transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s` on body to ensure smooth visual transitions when toggling themes.

The applyThemeToDOM function sets data attributes but does not dispatch a 'theme:changed' CustomEvent. The legacy vanilla JS code (src/js/ui.js, src/js/promotion-app.js) listens for this event. If any legacy pages are still in use during the migration, they won't react to React-driven theme changes. This is likely intentional for the SPA migration but worth noting for cross-page compatibility.

sharedStateObservations.observation: architecture.md states palettes use 'oklch/hsl color space' but the actual implementation uses hex values. The architecture doc should be updated to reflect the actual color format used.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The vitest --grep flag does not work with this project's vitest version (v4.0.16). The verification steps in features.json reference 'npx vitest run --grep theme' but this causes a CACError. The correct way to run a subset is 'npx vitest run tests/theme.test.tsx'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature description mentioned creating 'src/hooks/useTheme.ts' as a separate file, but the implementation co-located useTheme() with ThemeProvider in 'src/contexts/ThemeProvider.tsx'. The co-location pattern is a reasonable React convention but diverges from the feature spec file path.

summary: The theme system migration is complete and correct. ThemeProvider wraps the app with proper light/dark toggle, palette selection, and localStorage persistence. All 16 palettes are defined with CSS variable selectors. A blocking inline script in index.html prevents flash-of-wrong-theme. 41 tests pass covering all key behaviors. Minor non-blocking issues: loose PaletteName type, hex colors instead of oklch/hsl as described, no CSS transitions for theme switching, and no CustomEvent dispatch for legacy compatibility. None of these affect correctness of the React SPA theme system.
